description: `POST /api/v1/live-runs` (public): start a live run from a preset, on the owner's key (ADR-0007). Admission needs a Turnstile token in the `cf-turnstile-response` header, `attest_adult: true`, and a country Cloudflare reports; `503 live_disabled` when live mode is off.

attest_adult.description: The visitor's 18+ and territory acknowledgment. Absent reads as false, which the gate refuses (`422 attestation_required`).

judge_code.description: A judge-lane invite code, 1 to 256 characters once trimmed. An unknown code is not an error: the run takes the public lane, and nothing in the response says whether codes exist.

title: CreateLiveRunRequest
